name: services confederacy shared ledger activitypub wmap between microenterprises
asks: find me this resource is def like a micro-service, micro-enterprise, micro-hoare-program, so like, we can totally let that be a service a thing can offer - WITHIN its own Micro-Enterprise. So anything in lib/emsenn/src/services/ can import from anything it's got a contract with, and that means services/ even before we have any sort of inter-enterprise tooling set up since they're in an inherent confederacy - they all share the same ledger - but not from like, arbitrary other places. This is how we have a swarm AND hierarchy at the same time. But eventually we'll be using ActivityPub and other protocols to carry our WMAP packets between ME.
